name: io.github.jtauschl/openproject-ce-mcp
title: OpenProject CE
description: MCP server for OpenProject Community Edition with guarded read/write support.

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the OpenProject instance

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_READ_PROJECTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated project identifiers or glob patterns that may be read, * for all; unset allows none

environmentVariables.name: OPENPROJECT_WRITE_PROJECTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated project identifiers or glob patterns that may be written, * for all; unset allows none
